class PrOpenCompletionReceipt(TypedDict):
    pr_number: int | None

class PrOpenRecord(TypedDict):
    workerId: str
    workerClass: str
    ticketRef: str
    changeKind: str
    changeKindSource: str
    specRef: str
    riskClass: str
    title: str
    repo: str
    branch: str
    targetBranch: str
    worktreePath: str
    launchRequestId: str
    goalLineage: dict[str, Any]
    workspaceRepos: list[str]
    fromPlan: str
    planOwnedPostMergeActions: str
    planOwnedPostMergeActionsCommit: str
    planPostMergeActionsDeferredReason: str
    fromPlanRepo: str
    fromPlanRepoRoot: str
    fromPlanRawHash: str
    planTicketId: str
    salvage: bool
    draft: bool
    dryRun: bool
    prFinality: Literal["infer", "final", "not-final"]
    outcome: Literal["opened", "opened_url_missing", "dry-run"]
    prUrl: str
    headSha: str
    fastMergeCategory: str
    fastMergeLabel: str
    openedAt: str
    psrAfterAction: NotRequired[dict[str, Any]]
    backfilledAt: NotRequired[str]
    backfilledBy: NotRequired[str]

class PublicationReceiptRead:
    payload: dict[str, Any]
    opened: bool
    diagnostics: tuple[str, ...]

def read_pr_open_record(value: object) -> PublicationReceiptRead:
    """Interpret the historical D1 filter; diagnostics do not grant identity."""
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        return PublicationReceiptRead(
            {}, False, (f"{PR_OPEN_PRODUCER}: $ invalid; expected object",)
        )
    diagnostics = []
    for key in ("launchRequestId", "repo", "headSha", "prUrl"):
        if not isinstance(value.get(key), str) or not value[key]:
            diagnostics.append(f"{PR_OPEN_PRODUCER}: {key} missing/invalid nonempty string")
    outcome = value.get("outcome")
    if outcome not in ("opened", "opened_url_missing", "dry-run"):
        diagnostics.append(f"{PR_OPEN_PRODUCER}: outcome unrecognized {outcome!r}")
    elif outcome != "opened":
        diagnostics.append(f"{PR_OPEN_PRODUCER}: outcome={outcome!r} is not captured publication")
    if "dryRun" in value and type(value["dryRun"]) is not bool:
        diagnostics.append(f"{PR_OPEN_PRODUCER}: dryRun invalid; expected boolean")
    elif value.get("dryRun"):
        diagnostics.append(f"{PR_OPEN_PRODUCER}: dryRun=true is not publication")
    return PublicationReceiptRead(
        value,
        bool(outcome == "opened" and not value.get("dryRun") and value.get("prUrl")),
        tuple(diagnostics),
    )
